unknown_rule: Unknown is null in raw features, grade 4, never zero. Partial CFG is research_required.
threshold_basis: Expert powers-of-four bins; corpus distributions must accompany activation. Not fitted to desired targets or measured cost.
mixed_selection: function and initializer cohorts separate; no byte/instruction cross-kind comparison. Named data requires reviewed representation and consumer requirement evidence.
satisfaction: Only exact scope attestations satisfy requirements. A completed claim, extracted payload or pending declaration never implies callable behavior/layout.
bounded_source_port: callee_context proves only available original instructions or pinned provider source for reconstruction; callable_behavior remains unsatisfied until exact bounded replay evidence. All selected tasks require explicit declaration/layout/dispatch uncertainty scope and ordinary packet gates.
limitations: Static complexity is not runtime, tokens, cost, behavior, ABI or hardware evidence. Tail branches and literal address candidates remain observations.
